dataRecordMapping.description:
Provides a mapping from a data record returned by an api call, which may be in any shape,
to the shape required by the concrete data spec setting type implementation.

fieldName.description: The name of the field to which these settings apply

unidirectional.description: List of values to map to unidirectional edges pointing from a start node to an end node.

bidirectional.description: List of values to map to bidirectional edges.

reverse.description: List of values to map to unidirectional edges that go from the end node to the start node.

title:
Configuration to control how the edges are directed based on the value at the fieldName property.
The directionality of an edge can be specified by adding the field value in the appropriate directionality bucket below.
If the value at the specified field does not appear in any of the directionality buckets, the edge appears undirected.
name: UiSdlGraphVisualizationEdgeDirectionConfig
